decisions.reason: The charting bundle has its own page and frequent releases, so it shows active development, and as a map.apps add-on it costs little to keep while its value is still emerging.
This small search bundle is only mentioned on the website and its value is still uncertain, but keeping a plugin within the existing platform costs little, so the option stays open.
VueTOC was announced as a new solution approach on the home page and may later be folded into other components, but its prospects remain uncertain and it is cheap to maintain, so it is kept for now.
A GIS solution platform is close to the firm's core business and has strategic value, so abandoning it after one year would be premature.
Mobile field data capture has its own page and addresses a growing market among the firm's GIS customers, so the option is worth keeping open.
The search extension has its own page and complements the firm's map apps at low cost, so there is no evidence yet that would justify abandoning it.
